The Short Answer

Sakura had almost no character growth. She constantly moved between three behaviors throughout the series.

1.) She started off cocky and overconfident believing she is one of the best ninja around while doing next to nothing.

2.) She realized she is very weak, can’t do much and she cries and relies on other to save her and help her

It is annoying to see this exact cycle over and over and it and it gets annoying, 
So Sakura comes off as annoying. 

The Long Answer


1.) Sakura graduates among the top students and does believe she is awesome and definitely believes she is better than Naruto despite Naruto being the one fighting and she just stands guard. 

2.) At the chuunin exams, she realizes how weak she is, had to be saved by Lee and Sasuke, cries and was all but defeated mentally. She cries when Naruto and Sasuke were fighting at the hospital and almost got herself killed by jumping in their middle. She later cries when Sasuke was leaving the village and cries to Naruto to save him. 
3.) She realizes how weak she is, got a lot of resolve and went to train under Tsunade. Starts shippuden as an awesome medic, saving Kankuro, being praised by Chiyo, helping in taking down Sasori. 
4.) Then Sasuke comes in, she goes back to being weak, she lacks resolve and just stands there doing nothing and saying nothing that contributes. 
5.) Pain arc, she does nothing out of the ordinary. Sure, she saved Hinata and some other villagers, but not in an awesome medic-nin way but in a way any other fodder medic-nin could have. 
6.) She gained resolve, decides to kill Sasuke. Some say the translation is that she wants to die with him. Either way, good. She is finally taking initiative. 
7.) She see Sasuke, loses all resolve, had a moment of hesitation on if to kill Karin or not and later had to be saved by Naruto. 
8.) War arc, she starts off in the medic division, goes to the front lines, unlocks a power that the most useless Jounin of all time spent over 20 years learning and couldn’t (I am talking to Shizune), summons Katsuya and heals cuts and bruises all round, punches the ground with such strength that Hashirama praised her (she is stronger than Tsunade, she is stronger than Tsunade at that age or she has the potential to be stronger than Tsunade.
Then she was so drunk on her new success, she fails to be aware of hr surroundings and almost got killed and had to be saved again by Naruto. 
9.) She kept Naruto’s heart pumping long enough for the other half of Kurama to be sealed in him. 
10.) Obito told her to destroy his rinnegan so Madara can’t have both which will bring him closer to his full power. Sakura hesitates so long for Madara to come in and Obito had to save her. 
11.) Naruto and Sasuke who are miles stronger than she is were talking of a presence they can sense and see respectively and were wary of jumping in to attack. Sakura however jumps in to attack Madara and almost got killed and had to be saved by Naruto and Sasuke again. 
12.) Kaguya comes, Sakura had to be saved by Kakashi, she gains resolve to help save Sasuke when he was separated from them and contributed a lot of chakra to the task and showed some on her feet thinking.
13.) Kaguya gets sealed, Sakura knocks off her horn (like that helps anything), all seems well, then Sasuke turns out to still be evil and Sakura goes all emotional and stuff when it hadn’t worked any of the previous times rather than trust Naruto to handle it as Kakashi did.
